# INTERVAL multiplication
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/operators#interval_arithmetic_operators

# Whether BigQuery takes INT64 * INTERVAL, which its operators reference does not list, as
# GoogleSQL does.

SELECT 3 * INTERVAL 2 DAY
?>

# BigQuery's messages where a component leaves its range, and where it overflows INT64.

SELECT INTERVAL 2 YEAR * 10000
?>

SELECT INTERVAL 999999 DAY * 99999999999
?>
